catalysts.headline: Solstice announces Q3 2026 earnings date of November 4, 2026
Alongside the terminated Element Solutions merger, Solstice announced a $500M share buyback authorization; neither company paid a termination fee
Solstice and ESI mutually agreed to scrap their $14.5B merger
catalysts.impact: +12.76% on the close (+16% per one source)

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026: net sales $1,148M (+11% Y/Y), GAAP diluted EPS $0.75, adjusted diluted EPS $0.88 (beat ~$0.77-0.79 consensus); raised FY2026 guidance to net sales $4,125-4,185M, adjusted EBITDA $1,035-1,055M, adjusted diluted EPS $2.75-2.95

Solstice Advanced Materials agrees to acquire Element Solutions in a cash-and-stock deal valued at ~$14.5B (including assumed net debt); Element shareholders get $10 cash + 0.5 SOLS shares per ESI share; expected to close H1 2027
catalysts.impact: major; one source notes SOLS fell ~8.7% on the announcement (unconfirmed by a second source)

catalysts.headline: Solstice Advanced Materials completed its spin-off from Honeywell and began regular-way trading on Nasdaq under ticker SOLS; Honeywell shareholders received 1 SOLS share per 4 HON shares held (total distribution of 158,727,456 shares)
catalysts.impact: Company became an independent public company

conflicts: A single aggregator summary (surfaced via WebSearch, sourced to stockanalysis.com, which is egress-blocked in this sandbox) claims Solstice terminated a proposed ~$14.5 billion acquisition of Element Solutions and announced a new buyback plan. This could not be corroborated by any other source this session and looks suspect given Solstice's own reported market cap (~$12.55B, CNN) is smaller than the claimed deal size — flagged as unverified/possibly erroneous rather than reported as fact.

Market cap (~$12.55B, CNN, undated to the day) and FY2025 revenue (~$3.89B, stockanalysis.com summary) each rest on a single, not-independently-corroborated source and could not be cross-checked against a primary filing this session.

Several early-2026 analyst/corporate items (RBC upgrade to Outperform, UBS price target raised to $61, a planned $220M fiber-manufacturing investment) were found only with a vague 'January 2026' timeframe and no exact date, so per instructions they were excluded from the dated catalysts list.
notes: Theme 'Advanced Materials' fits well and is confirmed — Solstice is a Honeywell spin-off (completed 2025-10-30) producing specialty materials for refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data-center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, and healthcare packaging; themeLabel set to 'established' since the underlying businesses are mature (ex-Honeywell) franchises even though the standalone public company is less than one year old. Could not verify current market cap, float, short interest, cash, debt, EPS, or P/E from a primary source this session: WebFetch failed with DNS errors on every domain tested, SEC EDGAR was unreachable, and the WebSearch tool's shared quota was exhausted before dedicated follow-up searches could run. A claimed $14.5B Element Solutions acquisition/termination and buyback announcement could not be corroborated and is flagged as likely unreliable rather than reported as fact (see conflicts).
